The '''''Sword of Ieldis''''' was the flagship of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] during his campaign against his brother [[Daiman]]. The vessel shared its name a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] of the same name&mdash;the [[Sword of Ieldis]]&mdash;the [[Sith sword]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ieldis]], of the first [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].

Odion used the vessel to lead a defense of his mobile manufacturing [[Space station/Legends|space station]], [[The Spike (space station)|The Spike]]. The crew of the ''Sword of Ieldis'' was composed entirely of fanatical [[Odionate|Odionite]] [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] under the leadership of [[Jelcho]].
